title: AxiSim: GPU-accelerated axisymmetric CFD solver
description:
AxiSim is an interactive finite-volume solver for axisymmetric incompressible flow. It solves the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations in axisymmetric (r-z) coordinates using the finite-volume method and the SIMPLE pressure-velocity coupling scheme, with the linear algebra running on the GPU through CUDA.

Geometry sketching, structured and unstructured meshing, solving, and post-processing are combined in a single real-time interface. Optional scalar transport for energy (temperature) and concentration is supported, along with steady-state and transient modes.
